project: Wuxia Life Experience Governance Distributed Plan
description: Coordinate a multi-session experience governance phase that addresses event repetition, rhythm distribution, route dominance, and experience health gates without a one-shot rewrite.

userStories.title: Audit Event Lifecycle and History Sources
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want event lifecycle and history sources audited so repetition fixes target the real runtime path.
acceptanceCriteria: Runtime event history, player event records, and simulation script event execution paths are mapped
Mismatch between engine execution and script execution is documented
Events relying on triggerConditions.flags required/not are inventoried
No business code is changed during the audit

userStories.title: Unify Runtime Event Lifecycle Guards
userStories.description: As a player, I want repeated events to respect lifecycle rules consistently so the life simulation does not feel like a repeated event table.
acceptanceCriteria: Same-event maxTriggers and cooldown are enforced on the real execution path
triggerConditions.flags required/not behavior is either implemented or migrated with an explicit boundary
Simulation scripts use the same event history semantics as the runtime engine
Default validation and fixed-seed repetition checks pass

userStories.title: Define Category Lifecycle Boundaries
userStories.description: As a designer, I want family, romance, setback, career, and economy events to have clear lifecycle boundaries.
acceptanceCriteria: Category-specific repeat boundaries are documented
Family, romance, setback, career, and economy categories distinguish repeatable flavor from milestone events
Mandatory mainline events are protected from over-suppression
Fixed-seed reports show same-event and short-window same-class improvements

userStories.title: Audit Age-Band Event Distribution
userStories.description: As a designer, I want age-band event distribution measured so rhythm changes are based on evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Childhood, youth, adult, midlife, and elderly event pools are summarized
Formal, daily, storyline, family, setback, career, route, and ending ratios are reported by band
Top recurring candidates and high-weight wide-age events are listed
No business code is changed during the audit

userStories.title: Revise Candidate Pool Rhythm Strategy
userStories.description: As a player, I want the event pool to produce natural life rhythm rather than constant formal-event pressure.
acceptanceCriteria: Candidate pool selection no longer gives uncontrolled dominance to a small top-priority slice
Formal, daily, and storyline events have explicit selection boundaries
Daily fallback appears at a healthy rate without blocking mandatory events
Before/after rhythm metrics are recorded

userStories.title: Add Rhythm Regression Evidence
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want rhythm changes guarded by fixed-seed evidence so future content does not silently regress the pacing.
acceptanceCriteria: Rhythm report includes formal/daily ratio, empty ages, stage distribution, and top repeated candidates
At least one complete-life and one focused age-range sample are captured
Regression thresholds or observation baselines are documented
Default validation passes

userStories.title: Audit Route Loading and Route Metadata
userStories.description: As a designer, I want to know which route content is actually loaded and which metadata drives route scheduling.
acceptanceCriteria: Declared event imports are compared with the actual loader map
Route event metadata usage is counted, including routeTargets, routeTransition, pathAffinity, and route completion flags
Routes stuck in active state are identified from simulation reports
No business code is changed during the audit

userStories.title: Make Route Events Participate in Main Selection
userStories.description: As a player, I want a chosen life route to shape future events in a visible and sustained way.
acceptanceCriteria: Loaded route events can identify their target route or lifecycle role
Route-progress events receive scheduling support without starving daily or family events
At least two core routes show continuous route presence in fixed samples
Route conflict checks remain valid

userStories.title: Add Route Completion and Failure Samples
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want route completion and failure paths exercised by simulation so route structure is not only a state field.
acceptanceCriteria: At least two routes can reach completed or failed lifecycle states in fixed samples
Route completion rate is no longer consistently zero
Route lifecycle history is visible in reports
Default validation and route-focused simulation pass

userStories.title: Define Experience Health Metrics
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want experience health metrics that fail when the simulation is structurally valid but narratively unhealthy.
acceptanceCriteria: Metrics cover repetition, rhythm, route dominance, family/romance achievement, death concentration, and ending concentration
Each metric is classified as blocker, warning, or info
Waiver rules require explicit reasons
Metrics are documented before gate enforcement

userStories.title: Implement Multi-Sample Experience Gate
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want multi-sample simulation gates so one lucky seed cannot hide unhealthy experience patterns.
acceptanceCriteria: Gate runs multiple fixed seeds and personas
Gate emits machine-readable and human-readable summaries
Blocking experience failures return a failing exit code
Warning and info metrics remain visible in reports

userStories.title: Produce Experience Governance Closure Report
userStories.description: As a project owner, I want a closure report that explains what improved, what remains risky, and which thresholds protect future work.
acceptanceCriteria: Closure report lists changes, validation commands, metric deltas, and residual risks
Report references package A-D outcomes
Remaining warning-level risks are explicitly classified
No unrelated implementation scope is added
